title: Doom Patrol (TV series)
premise_summary: Doom Patrol is an American superhero television series developed by Jeremy Carver. Based on the DC Comics superhero team of the same name, the series features Jane, Rita Farr, Vic Stone, Larry Trainor, Cliff Steele, the Chief, and Madame Rouge as the members of the eponymous Doom Patrol. Although Bowlby, Bomer, and Fraser reprise their roles from the series Titans, the two shows are set in separate continuities.
